Trap: the usual workaround, a CLAUDE.md that holds `@AGENTS.md`, in the root and in a package. Launched headless (claude -p, the Agent SDK, CI) in packages/api, the root CLAUDE.md still loads, but its `@AGENTS.md` resolves outside the launch directory: an external import, which loads only after an approval recorded in ~/.claude.json. Nothing records one, so the root AGENTS.md never arrives, and the root CLAUDE.md switches off the reading of AGENTS.md that would otherwise have delivered it (rule claude.imports). Launched at the root, everything arrives.
